**STEP 1 - Scene:** A snack or light meal on a red dish: a whole apple, apple or pear slices, melon chunks, cherry tomatoes, and almonds.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A red dinner-sized plate, about 26 cm in diameter. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Whole apple
- Apple/pear slices and chunks (left side)
- Melon/cantaloupe pieces (right side)
- Cherry tomatoes (upper right)
- Almonds (lower right)

**STEP 4 - Area coverage (of 531 cm²):**
- Whole apple: ~7% (about 37 cm², ~7 cm across)
- Apple/pear pieces: ~8%
- Melon pieces: ~10%
- Cherry tomatoes: ~12%
- Almonds: ~22%
- Total covered: ~59%

**STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):**
- Apple: ~37 cm² × 6 cm ≈ 220 ml (whole fruit, so I use the mass directly)
- Apple/pear pieces: 42 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 85 ml
- Melon: 53 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 106 ml
- Tomatoes: 64 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 128 ml
- Almonds: 117 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 117 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams (× bulk density):**
- Apple: ~180 g (whole medium apple)
- Apple/pear pieces: 85 ml × 0.6 ≈ 51 g
- Melon: 106 ml × 0.6 ≈ 64 g
- Tomatoes: 128 ml × 0.6 ≈ 77 g
- Almonds: 117 ml × 0.6 ≈ 70 g
- Total ≈ 442 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Apple: 180 g × 52 kcal/100 g ≈ 94 kcal
- Apple/pear pieces: 51 g × 52 ≈ 27 kcal
- Melon: 64 g × 34 ≈ 22 kcal
- Tomatoes: 77 g × 18 ≈ 14 kcal
- Almonds: 70 g × 579 ≈ 405 kcal
- Total ≈ 562 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 440 g of mostly fruit with a moderate handful of almonds is plausible. The almonds supply most of the energy, which fits their high fat content. Estimates are rough, roughly ±25%.
